measure.measure_definition: Measured value: change from baseline in HbA1c at Week 24; Participants; HbA1c measured in site-specific accredited laboratories whose personnel were unaware of treatment assignment; change from baseline (Week 0) to Week 24.; Change = Week 24 HbA1c minus baseline HbA1c. Eligibility required screening HbA1c ≥7.0% to ≤10.5%. Non-inferiority criterion for the Test−Reference difference: upper bound of the two-sided 95% CI below 0.4%.

Measured value: change from baseline in fasting blood glucose at Week 24; Participants; Fasting blood glucose assessed at scheduled visits; change from baseline (Week 0) to Week 24. Assay details Not reported.; Change = Week 24 FBG minus baseline FBG; fasting sample. No non-inferiority criterion applies.

Measured value: change from baseline in post-prandial blood glucose at Week 24; Participants; Post-prandial blood glucose assessed at scheduled visits; change from baseline (Week 0) to Week 24. Meal timing and assay details Not reported.; Change = Week 24 PPBG minus baseline PPBG. No non-inferiority criterion applies.

Measured value: change from baseline in body weight at Week 24; Participants; Body weight measured at scheduled visits; change from baseline (Week 0) to Week 24. Measurement conditions Not reported.; Change = Week 24 body weight minus baseline body weight; absolute change in kg.

population.intervention: Test synthetic semaglutide injection (Sun Pharmaceutical Industries Limited)
population.intervention_regimen: 0.25 mg, 0.5 mg, 1 mg, and 2 mg once weekly; maximum 2.0 mg/week.; Subcutaneous once weekly for 24 weeks; 0.25 mg for Weeks 0–4, 0.5 mg for Weeks 4–8, then response-guided up-titration at Weeks 8, 12, 16 and 20 based on HbA1c (<7.5% continue; ≥7.5% increase) to a maximum of 2 mg once weekly.
population.population_definition: Randomised treatment allocation to Test synthetic semaglutide; per-protocol analysis set.; Adults aged 18–65 years with T2DM and screening HbA1c ≥7.0% to ≤10.5% despite stable metformin ≥1500 mg/day or maximum tolerated dose for ≥12 weeks plus diet and exercise; randomised 1:1 to Test semaglutide; per-protocol population defined as patients who completed the study without major protocol deviations.
population.population_time_frame: Treatment period Week 0 to Week 24; calendar dates Not reported.
